_how.what: Every output number of the Bellator Schedule Intelligence benchmark (our TypeScript copy, Bellatorsi API/) on its own test fixtures (tests/fixtures/schedules.ts: cleanChain, withFloat, withLogicIssues, withCycle, delayed, gamingHistory + gamingCurrent, overAllocated) and on two variants added for the clone's tests (logicVariety: a lag, a lead, SS/FF links, hard constraints, redundant links of two types; gaming.*_t2_started: gamingCurrent with an actual start on T2). Frozen: the clone's tests compare the clone-side figures with these where the clone's inputs coincide with the source's and state each difference.
produced_by: 1. cp -r "Bellatorsi API" /tmp/bw1/src-copy (the copy in the platform repo has `export` removed from its functions and constants: put it back in the scratch copy only: sed -i -E 's/^(async )?function /export \1function /' and sed -i -E 's/^(const|class) /export \1 /' over src/core, src/types, src/profiles, src/validation, src/endpoints)
2. npm install zod@3.24.1 --no-save --ignore-scripts inside the scratch copy (the endpoints parse their request with zod)
3. node --experimental-transform-types golden.ts > golden-raw.json (the script is below; Node 22; processing_time_ms is dropped from the envelopes, nothing else is changed)
4. this file = golden-raw.json with one section per line
notes: Each fixture section holds the source CPM (calendar days from day 0), float metrics, logic metrics and the endpoints that take tasks only: logic-audit, health score, schedule-risk-index (without and with status_date 2026-01-20), progress-audit and DECM at 2026-01-20, planning horizon, resource analysis (Crew: 1 unit/day, 30-day periods).

delayed also has the variance rows of computeTaskVariance against its own baseline dates, baseline-compare, as-planned-vs-built and delay-analysis (windows); gaming has change-tracking (history gamingHistory, current gamingCurrent at 2026-01-29) and the progress audit of gamingCurrent at 2026-01-29.
withCycle: the source CPM reports the loop in cpm.cycles and goes on with best-effort timings; the clone refuses to schedule a loop, so its tests assert the refusal, not these numbers.

Added for decm and planning_horizon: gaming.decm_history_* (the source with a schedule_history: retroactive actual dates), gaming.decm_t2_started_*, logicVariety.decm_*, and the fixture horizon (a purpose-made schedule with dates, resources and forecast drift, status date 2026-01-05; its tasks are in horizon.tasks, the source CPM beside them). Every earlier section was reproduced identically by the same script.
script: // Runs the Bellator source's own compute functions on its test fixtures and prints every output as JSON.
// Run: node --experimental-strip-types golden.ts > golden-raw.json   (src-copy = a copy of "Bellatorsi API/" with `export` put in front of its top-level functions)
import { cleanChain, withFloat, withLogicIssues, withCycle, delayed, gamingHistory, gamingCurrent, overAllocated } from './src-copy/tests/fixtures/schedules.ts';
const strip = (o: any): any => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o, (k, v) => (k === 'processing_time_ms' || k === 'generated_at' || k === 'request_id' ? undefined : v)));
const run = (f: () => unknown) => { try { return strip(f()); } catch (e) { return { error: String((e as Error).message).slice(0, 300) }; } };
const fixtures: Record<string, any[]> = { cleanChain, withFloat, withLogicIssues, withCycle, delayed, gamingCurrent, overAllocated };
o.cpm = { project_duration_days: cpm.project_duration_days, critical_path: cpm.critical_path, cycles: cpm.cycles, tasks: Object.fromEntries([...cpm.tasks.entries()].map(([k, v]) => [k, v])) };

o.health_score = run(() => computeHealthScore({ tasks: tasks.map((t: any) => ({ id: t.id, duration_days: t.duration_days ?? 0, predecessors: t.predecessors, percent_complete: t.percent_complete, planned_start: t.planned_start, planned_finish: t.planned_finish, name: t.name })) }));
o.progress_audit_status_2026_01_20 = run(() => computeProgressAudit({ tasks, options: { status_date: '2026-01-20' } }));
o.resource_analysis = run(() => computeResourceAnalysis({ tasks, resource_availability: [{ resource_name: 'Crew', units_per_day: 1 }], options: { period_size_days: 30 } }));
// delayed: variance against its own baseline, baseline compare, as-planned vs as-built, delay analysis
const baseline = delayed.map((t: any) => ({ id: t.id, baseline_start: t.baseline_start, baseline_finish: t.baseline_finish, duration_days: t.duration_days }));
const planned = delayed.map((t: any) => ({ id: t.id, planned_start: t.baseline_start, planned_finish: t.baseline_finish, duration_days: t.duration_days, predecessors: t.predecessors }));
out.delayed.variance = delayed.map((t: any) => computeTaskVariance(t, baseline.find((b: any) => b.id === t.id) as any));
out.delayed.baseline_compare = run(() => computeBaselineCompare({ current_schedule: { tasks: delayed, status_date: '2026-01-20' }, baseline_schedule: { tasks: baseline } }));
out.delayed.as_planned_vs_built = run(() => computeAsPlannedVsBuilt({ as_planned: { tasks: planned }, as_built: { tasks: delayed } }));
out.delayed.delay_analysis = run(() => computeDelayAnalysis({ tasks: delayed, status_date: '2026-01-20', options: { methodology: 'windows' } }));

out.gaming = { change_tracking: run(() => computeChangeTracking({ current_schedule: { tasks: gamingCurrent, status_date: '2026-01-29' }, schedule_history: gamingHistory })), progress_audit_status_2026_01_29: run(() => computeProgressAudit({ tasks: gamingCurrent, options: { status_date: '2026-01-29' } })) };
// variants added for the clone's tests (the clone cannot hold progress with no actual start in a started sense; and the source fixtures have no lag, SS, hard constraint or redundant link)
const gamingCurrentStarted = gamingCurrent.map((t: any) => (t.id === 'T2' ? { ...t, actual_start: '2026-01-20' } : t));
out.gaming.progress_audit_t2_started_status_2026_01_29 = run(() => computeProgressAudit({ tasks: gamingCurrentStarted, options: { status_date: '2026-01-29' } }));

{ const cpm = runCpm(logicVariety); out.logicVariety = { cpm: { project_duration_days: cpm.project_duration_days, tasks: Object.fromEntries([...cpm.tasks.entries()]) }, float_metrics: computeFloatMetrics(cpm), logic_metrics: computeLogicMetrics(logicVariety), logic_audit: run(() => computeLogicAudit({ tasks: logicVariety })) }; }

// added for the decm and planning_horizon tools (clone tests): DECM with a schedule history (retroactive actual dates), with T2 started, and on logicVariety; and the planning horizon on a purpose-made fixture with dates (horizon)
out.gaming.decm_history_status_2026_01_29 = run(() => computeDcmaDecm({ tasks: gamingCurrent, status_date: '2026-01-29', schedule_history: gamingHistory }));
out.logicVariety.decm_status_2026_01_20 = run(() => computeDcmaDecm({ tasks: logicVariety, status_date: '2026-01-20' }));

// horizon: P0 complete before the data date; planned dates = forecast dates (the clone's CPM from 2026-01-05, 7-day 24-hour calendar) except where a planned finish is earlier (forecast drift); resources R on A B D E G I; status 2026-01-05
const HD = (n: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 0, 5 + n)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const H = (id: string, d: number, preds: string[], s: number, res: boolean, drift = 0, extra: any = {}) => ({ id, duration_days: d, predecessors: preds, resources: res ? ['R'] : [], task_type: 'task', planned_start: HD(s), forecast_start: HD(s), forecast_finish: HD(s + d), planned_finish: HD(s + d - drift), ...extra });

{ const cpm = runCpm(horizon); out.horizon = { cpm: { project_duration_days: cpm.project_duration_days, tasks: Object.fromEntries([...cpm.tasks.entries()]) }, planning_horizon_status_2026_01_05: run(() => computePlanningHorizon({ tasks: horizon, status_date: '2026-01-05' })), tasks: horizon }; }
